title: Machine Learning Engineer
description_html: The Opportunity    The world of design is changing rapidly, and the Pro Design team is leading that transformation. We are the Adobe organization behind Illustrator, InDesign, and emerging experiences that connect creativity, collaboration, and AI. Our teams are reimagining what professional design looks like for the next decade - building intelligent, connected tools that empower creators and teams to move faster without sacrificing craft.  We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to power the intelligence inside our products. This is a hands-on modeling role for someone proficient in the full stack: classical discriminative to interpret, generative to produce, and agentic to act. Join us and build Adobe’s future products!     What you'll Do      Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to define problems, scope feasibility, and translate research into shipped experiences.    Design, prototype, and ship models powering product features, from predictive and ranking to generative and agentic systems, including RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, and in-product copilots for creative use cases.    Own evaluation end to end: define what "good" means, build offline and online evaluation harnesses, and detect quality regressions in production.    Build the data and MLOps foundations that keep models reliable: feature pipelines, experiment tracking, versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and monitoring.       What you need to succeed    Minimum Requirements:    Bachelor's in a quantitative field (CS, ML, Data Science, Engineering, or similar) or equivalent practical experience.    5+ years building, deploying, and operating ML systems in production at scale.    Strong core ML foundation: feature engineering and shipping supervised/unsupervised models for prediction, ranking, recommendation, or personalization.    Working depth in modern GenAI on top of that: LLMs or generative models in production (RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, or agent design).    Fluency in Python and SQL, and broader ML tooling and infrastructure ecosystem.    Rigorous offline and online evaluation and experimentation design and operation.    Ability to frame problems before modeling, and to communicate technical work clearly to non-technical Product and Design partners.      Preferred Requirements:    Master's or PhD in a quantitative discipline.    Background in consumer product analytics, especially in creative tools, SaaS, or subscription businesses.    Experience with recommendation systems or personalization especially for visual or creative content.    Experience deploying and monitoring models in Databricks (MLflow, Feature Store, model serving) or a comparable production ML environment.       About Adobe   Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.    Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.     Let’s Adobe together   At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our    values and culture   ,    focus on people, purpose and community   ,    Adobe for All   , comprehensive    benefits programs   , the    stories we tell   , the    customers    we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.    Adobe is proud to be an    Equal Employment Opportunity    employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.    Learn more.       Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email    accommodations@adobe.com    or call +1 408-536-3015.      AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:  Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.    At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about    AI in the hiring experience   .      Expected Pay Range:  Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $133,100 -- $236,400 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.     &#xa;&#xa;In California, the pay range for this position is $163,200 - $236,400&#xa;   At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans.  Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).    In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Web & Ecommerce
Software Engineer, Ingénieur Logiciel – Platform & Emerging Technologies
description_html: Job Requisition ID #                      26WD99401      Software Engineer (C++)– Platform & Emerging Technologies  Montreal or Toronto   Position Overview    Autodesk is looking for a Software Engineer to help build the next generation of cloud services, data platforms, and AI-powered capabilities that support Autodesk products and customers worldwide.    In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and evolution of scalable services and platform capabilities that power Autodesk's growing SaaS ecosystem. You will work alongside experienced engineers, architects, product managers, and UX designers to develop high-quality solutions that enable innovation across Autodesk's products and services.    You will have the opportunity to contribute to cloud-native services, APIs, data platforms, and emerging AI-powered experiences while gaining hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices and large-scale distributed systems.    This position is ideal for engineers who are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and excited to solve complex problems in a collaborative environment.      Responsibilities    Software Development     Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions.    Contribute to the development of cloud services, APIs, and platform capabilities.    Participate in the design and implementation of new features and enhancements.    Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.    Develop automated tests to ensure software quality and reliability.    Participate in code reviews and apply software engineering best practices.    Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and production issues.     Platform & Cloud Development     Contribute to the development of scalable SaaS and cloud-based solutions.    Help build and maintain APIs and backend services.    Participate in improving platform reliability, performance, and operational excellence.    Support the evolution of data platforms and intelligent platform capabilities.    Learn and apply cloud-native development principles and modern engineering practices.     Collaboration & Learning     Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, Architects, and fellow engineers to deliver customer value.    Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and delivery activities.    Work closely with team members to solve technical challenges and share knowledge.    Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and engineering practices.    Contribute ideas that improve products, processes, and developer experiences.       Minimum Qualifications     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    2–5 years of software development experience.    Strong proficiency in modern software development technologies, including:   C++ and Python  Object-oriented design and software architecture principles     Desired proficiency with:   TypeScript  .NET/C#  Java and Spring Boot     Understanding of software development fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.    Basic understanding of APIs and web services.    Interest in cloud computing and SaaS technologies.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Good communication and teamwork skills.    Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced environment.       Preferred Qualifications     Experience with Java and Spring Boot through academic, personal, internship, or professional projects.    Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.    Knowledge of REST APIs and distributed systems concepts.    Experience with Git and source control systems.    Familiarity with automated testing practices.    Interest in data platforms, artificial intelligence, or cloud-native technologies.    Participation in open-source, academic, or personal software projects.       What You'll Gain     Hands-on experience building SaaS and cloud-based platforms at scale.    Exposure to modern software architecture and distributed systems.    Opportunities to work with data platforms, APIs, and emerging AI technologies.    Mentorship from experienced engineers and technical leaders.    Experience working in a global engineering organization focused on innovation and continuous learning.       Key Success Factors     Curiosity and willingness to learn.    Strong collaboration and communication skills.    Commitment to software quality and continuous improvement.    Ability to solve problems effectively and take ownership of assigned work.    Passion for technology and innovation.    Desire to help build solutions that enable Autodesk customers to imagine, design, and make a better world.       Ingénieur(e) logiciel – Plateformes et technologies émergentes    Présentation du poste    Autodesk est à la recherche d’un(e) Ingénieur(e) logiciel passionné(e) pour contribuer au développement de la prochaine génération de services infonuagiques, de plateformes de données et de solutions alimentées par l’intelligence artificielle.    Dans ce rôle, vous participerez à la conception, au développement et à l’évolution de services et de capacités de plateforme évolutifs qui soutiennent l’écosystème SaaS d’Autodesk. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d’ingénieurs expérimentés, d’architectes, de gestionnaires de produit et de concepteurs UX afin de développer des solutions de grande qualité favorisant l’innovation à travers les produits et services Autodesk.    Vous aurez l’occasion de contribuer à des services cloud-native, à des API, à des plateformes de données ainsi qu’à des expériences émergentes propulsées par l’intelligence artificielle, tout en développant votre expertise dans les pratiques modernes de développement logiciel et les systèmes distribués à grande échelle.    Ce poste est idéal pour les ingénieurs passionnés par la technologie, motivés à apprendre et enthousiastes à l’idée de résoudre des problèmes complexes dans un environnement collaboratif.      Responsabilités    Développement logiciel     Concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir des solutions logicielles de haute qualité.    Contribuer au développement de services infonuagiques, d’API et de capacités de plateforme.    Participer à la conception et à l’implantation de nouvelles fonctionnalités et améliorations.    Produire du code propre, maintenable et bien documenté.    Développer des tests automatisés afin d’assurer la qualité et la fiabilité des solutions.    Participer aux revues de code et appliquer les meilleures pratiques d’ingénierie logicielle.    Diagnostiquer et corriger les anomalies logicielles et les problèmes de production.     Développement SaaS, Cloud et Plateformes     Contribuer au développement de solutions SaaS et infonuagiques évolutives.    Participer à la création et à l’évolution d’API et de services backend.    Contribuer à l’amélioration de la fiabilité, de la performance et de l’excellence opérationnelle des plateformes.    Participer à l’évolution des plateformes de données et des capacités intelligentes.    Apprendre et appliquer les principes du développement cloud-native et les pratiques modernes d’ingénierie.     Collaboration et apprentissage     Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produit, concepteurs UX, architectes et autres ingénieurs afin de livrer de la valeur aux clients.    Participer aux activités de planification, d’estimation et de livraison dans un environnement Agile.    Travailler étroitement avec les membres de l’équipe afin de résoudre des défis techniques et partager les connaissances.    Développer continuellement ses compétences techniques et découvrir de nouvelles technologies.    Contribuer à l’amélioration des produits, des processus et de l’expérience développeur.       Qualifications minimales     Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, génie informatique ou domaine connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente.    De 2 - 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel.    Bonne connaissance de Java et des principes de programmation orientée objet.    Familiarité avec Spring Boot ou intérêt à apprendre les technologies modernes de développement backend.    Compréhension des fondements du développement logiciel, des structures de données et des algorithmes.    Compréhension de base des API et des services web.    Intérêt pour les technologies infonuagiques et les solutions SaaS.    Excellentes aptitudes analytiques et de résolution de problèmes.    Bonnes compétences en communication et en travail d’équipe.    Capacité à apprendre rapidement dans un environnement dynamique.       Qualifications souhaitées    Solide maîtrise des technologies modernes de développement logiciel, notamment : C++ et Python  Les principes de conception orientée objet et d’architecture logicielle  Une bonne maîtrise des technologies suivantes est considérée comme un atout :  TypeScript  .NET / C#  Java et Spring Boot     Familiarité avec AWS ou d’autres plateformes infonuagiques.    Connaissance des API REST et des concepts de systèmes distribués.    Expérience avec Git et les systèmes de gestion du code source.    Familiarité avec les tests automatisés.    Intérêt pour les plateformes de données, l’intelligence artificielle ou les technologies cloud-native.    Participation à des projets open source, académiques ou personnels.       Ce que vous développerez dans ce rôle     Une expérience concrète dans le développement de plateformes SaaS et infonuagiques à grande échelle.    Une exposition aux architectures logicielles modernes et aux systèmes distribués.    Des connaissances pratiques en plateformes de données, API et technologies d’intelligence artificielle émergentes.    L’accompagnement d’ingénieurs et de leaders techniques expérimentés.    Une expérience au sein d’une organisation mondiale axée sur l’innovation et l’apprentissage continu.       Facteurs clés de réussite     Curiosité et volonté d’apprendre.    Excellentes aptitudes de collaboration et de communication.    Souci de la qualité et de l’amélioration continue.    Capacité à résoudre efficacement les problèmes et à prendre en charge les responsabilités confiées.    Passion pour la technologie et l’innovation.    Désir de contribuer à des solutions qui permettent aux clients Autodesk d’imaginer, de concevoir et de créer un monde meilleur.        Plus d'information/ Learn More        À propos d’Autodesk/ About Autodesk     Bienvenue chez Autodesk ! Nos logiciels créent chaque jour des choses extraordinaires : des bâtiments les plus écologiques aux voitures les plus propres, en passant par les usines les plus intelligentes et les films à succès. Nous aidons les innovateurs à concrétiser leurs idées, transformant non seulement la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées, mais aussi ce qui peut l’être. Nous sommes très fiers de notre culture chez Autodesk ; elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre culture guide notre façon de travailler et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres, influence nos interactions avec nos clients et nos partenaires, et définit notre image au monde. En tant qu’Autodeskien, vous pouvez accomplir un travail significatif qui contribue à bâtir un monde meilleur, conçu et réalisé pour tous. Prêt à façonner le monde et votre avenir ? Rejoignez-nous !    Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.    We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.    When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!       Transparence salariale / Salary transparency  Le salaire est l'un des éléments du programme de rémunération concurrentiel d'Autodesk. Pour les postes basés au Canada, nous offrons un salaire de base entre $88,000 et $128,700. Le salaire est déterminé selon l'expérience professionnelle et l'emplacement du candidat(e). En plus du salaire de base, notre programme de rémunération peut inclure une prime annuelle, des commissions pour les postes de ventes, des attributions d'actions et un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux.&#xa;&#xa;Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.   appurtenance / Belonging    Nous sommes fiers de cultiver une culture d’appartenance où chacun peut s’épanouir.
